title: Tamar, Judah's Daughter-in-Law
lead: A widowed daughter-in-law of Judah who, when denied the brother-in-law marriage owed to her, disguised herself and conceived twins by Judah himself (Genesis 38). Her son Perez began the line that led to Boaz and David (Ruth 4:12, 18; 1 Chronicles 2:4), and Matthew names her in Jesus' genealogy (Matthew 1:3). (Not to be confused with David's daughter Tamar, 2 Samuel 13.)
